name: Elizabeth Holmes

summary.text: Elizabeth Holmes founded the blood-testing company Theranos and was its chief executive. A federal jury in San Jose convicted her in January 2022 on four of eleven counts of defrauding investors. On November 18, 2022 U.S. District Judge Edward Davila sentenced her to 135 months (about 11¼ years) in prison followed by three years of supervised release, finding a total investor loss of about $121 million; she was ordered to report to prison on April 27, 2023. Her former deputy Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani, convicted on all twelve counts against him, was sentenced to 155 months weeks later.
